findings.summary: The frozen verification record metadata names implementation SHA 28774245e9eb01138a53eb174ec579c2ede58fed, while its details and runtime evidence verify evaluated SHA 7b98413caecc2a1f2745fc12d5dd535f531c7a41.
findings.broken_invariant: Verification evidence should bind consistently to the evaluated implementation SHA; the deterministic runtime evidence resolves the discrepancy for this review, but the record metadata remains internally inconsistent.

hidden_assumptions: The one-token increase inside an existing clone group is non-material because clone count and duplicated-line count returned to the pre-beta.2 baseline and the clone ratchet passed.
